translations.idiomatic: Li Ji often told people, "When I was twelve or thirteen I was a good-for-nothing bandit and killed anyone I met.

sentences.zh: 十四五為難當賊，有所不愜則殺人。

translations.literal: At fourteen or fifteen I was a hard-to-beat bandit—when something displeased me I killed people.
translations.idiomatic: At fourteen or fifteen I was a hard-to-beat bandit—when something displeased me I killed people.

sentences.zh: 十七八為佳賊，臨陳乃殺之。

translations.literal: At seventeen or eighteen I was a fine bandit and killed only on the battlefield.
translations.idiomatic: At seventeen or eighteen I was a fine bandit and killed only in battle.

sentences.zh: 二十為大將，用兵以救人死。」

translations.literal: At twenty I became a great general and used arms to save men from death."
translations.idiomatic: At twenty I became a great general and used arms to save men from death."

sentences.zh: 勣長子震早卒，震子敬業襲爵。

translations.literal: Li Ji's eldest son Zhen died early; Zhen's son Jingye inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: Li Ji's eldest son Zhen died early; Zhen's son Jingye inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 時承平既久，選人益多，是歲，司列少常伯裴行儉始與員外郎張仁示韋，設長名姓歷榜，引銓注之法。

translations.literal: Long peace had lasted, and candidates for office grew ever more numerous; that year Vice Minister of the Directorate of Personnel Pei Xingjian, together with Outer Section Vice Director Zhang Renyi, first established the long-name register and brought in the selection-and-assignment method.
translations.idiomatic: Long peace had lasted, and candidates for office grew ever more numerous; that year Pei Xingjian, vice minister of the directorate of personnel, together with Zhang Renyi, outer section vice director, first established the long-name register and brought in the selection-and-assignment method.

sentences.zh: 又定州縣升降、官資高下。

translations.literal: He also fixed the grades for promoting and demoting prefectures and counties, and the ranks of official qualifications.
translations.idiomatic: He also fixed the grades for promoting and demoting prefectures and counties and the ranks of official qualifications.

sentences.zh: 其後遂為永制，無能革之者。

translations.literal: Thereafter it became a permanent system that none could reform.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter it became a permanent system that none could reform.

sentences.zh: 大略唐之選法，取人以身、言、書、判，計資量勞而擬官。

translations.literal: In broad outline, Tang's selection method took men by physique, speech, calligraphy, and case judgment, tallying seniority and merit to propose office.
translations.idiomatic: In broad outline, Tang's selection method judged men by physique, speech, calligraphy, and case judgment, tallying seniority and merit to propose appointments.

sentences.zh: 始集而試，觀其書、判；

translations.literal: First they were gathered and tested, examining calligraphy and case judgment;
translations.idiomatic: First they were gathered and tested, examining calligraphy and case judgment;

sentences.zh: 已試而銓，察其身、言；

translations.literal: after testing came selection, inspecting physique and speech;
translations.idiomatic: after testing came selection, inspecting physique and speech;

sentences.zh: 已銓而注，詢其便利；

translations.literal: after selection came assignment, inquiring as to convenience;
translations.idiomatic: after selection came assignment, inquiring as to convenience;

sentences.zh: 已注而唱，集眾告之。

translations.literal: after assignment came announcement, assembling the crowd to proclaim it.
translations.idiomatic: after assignment came announcement, assembling the crowd to proclaim it.

sentences.zh: 然後類以為甲，先簡僕射，乃上門下，給事中讀，侍郎省，侍中審之，不當者駁下。

translations.literal: Then they were classified and ranked; first screened by the Grand Secretariat Director, then submitted to the Ministry of State Affairs; the Drafting Attendant read them, the Vice Minister examined them, the Chief Minister reviewed—what was improper was sent back.
translations.idiomatic: Then they were classified and ranked; first screened by the Grand Secretariat Director, then submitted to the Ministry of State Affairs; the drafting attendant read them, the vice minister examined them, the chief minister reviewed—and what was improper was sent back.

sentences.zh: 既審，然後上聞，主者受旨奉行，各給以符，謂之告身。

translations.literal: Once reviewed, it was reported upward; the responsible official received the command and carried it out, issuing each man a tally called a commission of appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Once reviewed, it was reported upward; the responsible official received the command and carried it out, issuing each man a tally called a commission of appointment.

sentences.zh: 兵部武選亦然。

translations.literal: Military selection by the Ministry of War was the same.
translations.idiomatic: Military selection by the Ministry of War followed the same procedure.

sentences.zh: 課試之法，以騎射及翹關、負米。

translations.literal: The examination method used mounted archery, lifting the gate-bar, and carrying rice.
translations.idiomatic: The examination method used mounted archery, lifting the gate-bar, and carrying rice.

sentences.zh: 人有格限未至，而能試文三篇，謂之宏詞，試判三條，謂之拔萃，入等者得不限而授。

translations.literal: If a man's qualification grade had not yet been reached yet he could pass three literary essays—called "grand words"—or three case judgments—called "selection outstanding"—those who entered the grade could be appointed without regard to limit.
translations.idiomatic: If a man's qualification grade had not yet been reached yet he could pass three literary essays—called hongci—or three case judgments—called baeji—those who entered the grade could be appointed without regard to limit.

sentences.zh: 其黔中、嶺南、閩中州縣官，不由吏部，委都督選擇士人補授。

translations.literal: Prefectural and county officials in Qianzhong, Lingnan, and Minzhong were not handled by the Ministry of Personnel; area commissioners were entrusted to select men of quality to fill the posts.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectural and county officials in Qianzhong, Lingnan, and Minzhong were not handled by the Ministry of Personnel; area commissioners were entrusted to select local men of quality to fill the posts.

sentences.zh: 凡居官以年為考，六品以下，四考為滿。

translations.literal: In general, holding office was assessed by year; for sixth rank and below, four assessments constituted a full term.
translations.idiomatic: In general, holding office was assessed by year; for sixth rank and below, four assessments constituted a full term.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，丁丑，右相劉仁軌請致仕；

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on dingchou, Right Chancellor Liu Rengui requested retirement;
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month, on dingchou, Right Chancellor Liu Rengui asked to retire;

sentences.zh: 許之。

translations.literal: It was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 三月，甲戌朔，以旱，赦天下，改元。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the first day of the month, jiaxu, because of drought, he amnestied the realm and changed the era name.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the new moon of jiaxu, owing to drought, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，改蓬萊宮為含元宮。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Penglai Palace was renamed Hanyuan Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Penglai Palace was renamed Hanyuan Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，太子少師許敬宗請致仕；

translations.literal: On renchen, Junior Preceptor to the Crown Prince Xu Jingzong requested retirement;
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Xu Jingzong, junior preceptor to the Crown Prince, asked to retire;

sentences.zh: 許之。

translations.literal: It was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 敕突厥酋長子弟事東宮。

translations.literal: An edict ordered sons of Turkic chieftains to serve the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commanded sons of Turkic chieftains to attend upon the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 西台舍人徐齊聃上疏，以為：「皇太子當引文學端良之士置左右，豈可使戎狄丑類入侍軒闥！」

translations.literal: Writer of the Western Chancellery Xu Qidan submitted a memorial, stating: "The Crown Prince ought to bring forth cultured, upright men and place them at his side—how can ugly barbarian kinds be allowed to attend within the palace gate!"
translations.idiomatic: Xu Qidan, writer of the Western Chancellery, submitted a memorial arguing: "The Crown Prince should bring literary, upright men to his side—how can vile barbarians be allowed to wait upon him in the palace chambers!"

sentences.zh: 又奏：「齊獻公即陛下外祖，雖子孫有犯，豈應上延祖檷！

translations.literal: He further memorialized: "Duke Gong of Qi is Your Majesty's maternal grandfather—though his descendants have offenses, how should punishment extend upward to his ancestral shrine!
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote: "Duke Gong of Qi is Your Majesty's maternal grandfather. Though his descendants have committed offenses, how can punishment reach upward to his ancestral shrine!

sentences.zh: 今周忠孝公廟甚修，而齊獻公廟毀廢，不審陛下何以垂示海內，彰孝理之風！」

translations.literal: Now the temple of Duke Zhongxiao of Zhou is well maintained, yet the temple of Duke Gong of Qi lies ruined and abandoned—I do not know how Your Majesty intends to show this to the realm and make manifest the wind of filial governance!"
translations.idiomatic: The temple of Duke Zhongxiao of Zhou is splendidly kept up, yet the temple of Duke Gong of Qi stands ruined and abandoned. I cannot see how Your Majesty means to set an example for the realm and proclaim the spirit of filial rule!"

sentences.zh: 上皆從之。

translations.literal: The emperor accepted all of it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved all his proposals.

sentences.zh: 齊聃，充容之弟也。

translations.literal: Qidan was the younger brother of Chongrong.
translations.idiomatic: Qidan was the younger brother of Chongrong.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，吐蕃陷西域十八州，又與于闐襲龜茲撥換城，陷之。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, Tubo captured eighteen prefectures of the Western Regions; it also joined with Khotan to raid Kucha's city of Bochuang and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, Tubo overran eighteen prefectures in the Western Regions and, together with Khotan, assaulted Bochuang in Kucha and took it.

sentences.zh: 罷龜茲、于闐、焉耆、疏勒四鎮。

translations.literal: The four garrisons of Kucha, Khotan, Karasahr, and Kashgar were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The four garrisons of Kucha, Khotan, Karasahr, and Kashgar were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以右衛大將軍薛仁貴為邏娑道行軍大總管，左衛員外大將軍阿史那道真、左衛將軍郭待封副之，以討吐蕃，且援送吐谷渾還故地。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Right Guard Grand General Xue Rengui was made Grand Campaign Commander of the Luosuo Route; Left Guard Extra Grand General Ashina Daozhen and Left Guard General Guo Daifeng were made his deputies, to attack Tubo and also to escort and restore the Tuyuhun to their former lands.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Xue Rengui, grand general of the Right Guard, was appointed grand campaign commander on the Luosuo Route, with Ashina Daozhen, outer-rank grand general of the Left Guard, and Guo Daifeng, general of the Left Guard, as his deputies, to strike Tubo and escort the Tuyuhun back to their homeland.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上幸九成宮。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the emperor visited Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the emperor went to Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 高麗酋長劍牟岑反，立高藏外孫安舜為主。

translations.literal: Goguryeo chieftain Jian Mucen rebelled and installed Gao Zang's grandson An Shun as leader.
translations.idiomatic: The Goguryeo chieftain Jian Mucen rose in revolt and set up An Shun, a grandson of Gao Zang, as their leader.

sentences.zh: 以左監門大將軍高侃為東州道行軍總管，發兵討之，安舜殺劍牟岑，奔新羅。

translations.literal: Left Gate Inspector Grand General Gao Kan was made Campaign Commander of the Eastern Route; troops were raised to attack them. An Shun killed Jian Mucen and fled to Silla.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Kan, grand general of the Left Gate Inspectorate, was made campaign commander on the Eastern Route and sent troops against them. An Shun killed Jian Mucen and fled to Silla.

sentences.zh: 六月，壬寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the first day of the month, renyin, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the new moon of renyin, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 秋，八月，丁巳，車駕還京師。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, on dingsi, the imperial carriage returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the eighth month, on dingsi, the emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 郭待封先與薛仁貴並列，及征吐蕃，恥居其下，仁貴所言，待封多違之。

translations.literal: Guo Daifeng had formerly been ranked equal with Xue Rengui; when they campaigned against Tubo, he was ashamed to serve beneath him, and of what Rengui proposed, Daifeng often went against it.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Daifeng had once been Xue Rengui's equal in rank; on the campaign against Tubo he resented serving under him and often defied Rengui's decisions.

sentences.zh: 軍至大非川，將趣烏海，仁貴曰：「烏海險遠，軍行甚難，輜重自隨，難以趨利；

translations.literal: When the army reached Dafeichuan and was about to press toward Wuhai, Rengui said: "Wuhai is perilous and far; the march is very difficult. With baggage trains following, it is hard to seize advantage;
translations.idiomatic: When the army reached Dafeichuan and was about to advance on Wuhai, Rengui said: "Wuhai lies far across dangerous country, and the march will be arduous. Lugging baggage trains along, we cannot hope to strike swiftly;

sentences.zh: 宜留二萬人，為兩柵於大非嶺上，輜重悉置柵內，吾屬帥輕銳，倍道兼行，掩其未備，破之必矣。」

translations.literal: it would be best to leave twenty thousand men and build two stockades on Dafei Ridge, placing all baggage entirely within the stockades; our party should lead light, elite troops by forced marches day and night to strike them unprepared—defeating them is certain."
translations.idiomatic: Leave twenty thousand men and build two stockades on Dafei Ridge; put all supplies inside. We should lead the light, picked troops by forced marches to catch them off guard—we are sure to break them."

sentences.zh: 仁貴帥所部前行，擊吐蕃於河口，大破之，斬獲甚眾，進屯烏海以俟待封。

translations.literal: Rengui led his division forward, struck Tubo at Hekou, and routed them, killing and capturing in great numbers; he advanced and encamped at Wuhai to await Daifeng.
translations.idiomatic: Rengui led his own force ahead, attacked Tubo at Hekou, and won a great victory, killing and capturing many; he then advanced and encamped at Wuhai to wait for Daifeng.

sentences.zh: 待封不用仁貴策，將輜重徐進，未至烏海，遇吐蕃二十餘萬，待封軍大敗，還走，悉棄輜重。

translations.literal: Daifeng did not use Rengui's plan; he moved the baggage train slowly forward. Before reaching Wuhai, he met more than two hundred thousand Tubo troops; Daifeng's army was badly defeated and fled back, abandoning all baggage.
translations.idiomatic: Daifeng ignored Rengui's plan and advanced the baggage train at a crawl. Before he reached Wuhai he ran into more than two hundred thousand Tubo troops; his army was routed and fled, abandoning all supplies.

sentences.zh: 仁貴退屯大非川，吐蕃相論欽陵將兵四十餘萬就擊之，唐兵大敗，死傷略盡。

translations.literal: Rengui withdrew and encamped at Dafeichuan. Tubo chancellor Lun Qinling led more than four hundred thousand troops to attack him; Tang forces were badly defeated and the dead and wounded were nearly all lost.
translations.idiomatic: Rengui fell back to Dafeichuan. Lun Qinling, Tubo's chief minister, brought more than four hundred thousand men against him; the Tang army was shattered and almost wiped out.

sentences.zh: 仁貴、待封與阿史那道真並脫身免，與欽陵約和而還。

translations.literal: Rengui, Daifeng, and Ashina Daozhen all escaped with their lives, made peace with Qinling, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Rengui, Daifeng, and Ashina Daozhen all escaped alive, negotiated peace with Qinling, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 敕大司憲樂彥瑋即軍中按其敗狀，械送京師，三人皆免死除名。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Grand Censor Yue Yanwei to investigate on the spot in the army the circumstances of their defeat, send them in fetters to the capital—all three were spared death but dismissed from office and struck from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Grand Censor Yue Yanwei to investigate the defeat in camp and send the three men to the capital in chains. All were spared execution but stripped of rank and removed from office.

sentences.zh: 欽陵，祿東贊之子也，與弟贊婆、悉多於、勃論皆有才略。

translations.literal: Qinling was the son of Gar Tongtsen; with his younger brothers Zanpo, Xiduoyu, and Blon, all had talent and stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: Qinling was the son of Gar Tongtsen. He and his younger brothers Zanpo, Xiduoyu, and Blon were all men of talent and military skill.

sentences.zh: 祿東贊卒，欽陵代之秉政，三弟將兵居外，鄰國畏之。

translations.literal: When Gar Tongtsen died, Qinling replaced him in holding government; the three younger brothers commanded troops abroad, and neighboring states feared them.
translations.idiomatic: After Gar Tongtsen died, Qinling took control of the government while his three brothers commanded armies on the frontiers, and neighboring states feared them.

sentences.zh: 關中旱，饑。

translations.literal: In Guanzhong there was drought and famine.
translations.idiomatic: Guanzhong suffered drought and famine.

sentences.zh: 九月，丁丑，詔以明年正月幸東都。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dingchou, an edict announced that in the first month of the next year the emperor would visit the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingchou, an edict announced an imperial visit to the Eastern Capital in the first month of the following year.

sentences.zh: 甲申，皇后母魯國忠烈夫人楊氏卒，敕文武九品以上及外命婦並詣宅吊哭。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the empress's mother, Lady Yang, Duchess of Lu and Lady of Loyal Valor, died; an edict ordered civil and military officials of the ninth rank and above, and all externally ennobled women, to go to the residence to mourn and weep.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Lady Yang, the empress's mother, Duchess of Lu and Lady of Loyal Valor, died. An edict commanded civil and military officials of the ninth rank and above, together with externally ennobled ladies, to come to the house and offer condolences.

sentences.zh: 閨月，癸卯，皇后以久旱，請避位；

translations.literal: In the gui month, on guimao, because of long drought the empress requested to withdraw from her position;
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on guimao, owing to the prolonged drought the empress asked to abdicate;

sentences.zh: 不許。

translations.literal: It was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was refused.

sentences.zh: 壬子，加贈司徒周忠孝公武士擭為太尉、太原王，夫人為王妃。

translations.literal: On renzi, posthumous honors were further conferred: Grand Preceptor, Duke Zhongxiao of Zhou, Wu Shihuo was made Grand Marshal and King of Taiyuan; his lady was made a royal consort.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, additional posthumous honors were granted: Wu Shihuo, Duke Zhongxiao of Zhou, already made grand preceptor, was further ennobled as grand marshal and King of Taiyuan, and his wife was made a royal consort.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以左相姜恪為涼州道行軍大總管，以御吐蕃。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Left Chancellor Jiang Ke was made Grand Campaign Commander of the Liangzhou Route to repel Tubo.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Jiang Ke, Left Chancellor, was appointed grand campaign commander on the Liangzhou Route to defend against Tubo.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，乙未，太子右中護、同東西台三品趙仁本為左肅機，罷政事。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on yiwei, Crown Prince's Right Central Guard and Third Rank Associate of Both Eastern and Western Offices Zhao Renben was made Left Suoji and removed from government affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on yiwei, Zhao Renben, crown prince's right central guard and Third Rank Associate of Both Eastern and Western Offices, was made Left Suoji and removed from the government.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔官名皆復舊。

translations.literal: On gengyin, an edict ordered that all office names be restored to the old forms.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, an edict commanded that all official titles be restored to their former names.
